# Resume fonts

Noto Sans Regular and Bold are bundled under the SIL Open Font License in LICENSE.

Primary source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans

Downloaded 18 October 2026. The matching base64 module lib/resume-fonts.ts makes PDF export independent of network font requests. No user content is sent to a font or document service. PDF generation checks glyph coverage and reports unsupported characters instead of silently substituting them.
